reviews.text:
BUYERS BEWARE - Jennifer sold us a used and damaged floor model. This was not agreed on or in the contract.
There are violations according to the DTPA and many more.codes i can state they are in violation of.
We have been trying to speak to the owner Dan and still blocked from talking to him . If this is not made right well go legal . This place used to be amazing and now its.gone downhill.
I have a whole time.line of specifics if you want to mess with me . I can go all day.

JENNIFER the store manager lied but I was told from another location that Rob is the store manager so idk whose telling the truth now  .   . Jennifer said in exact words we could get the hot tub delivered when we wanted or possibly same day . I made a $200.deposit and signed on the $200.  We came back Friday to make the transaction of 5400 in which the price was wrong !!! She wanted my signature. I had questions and wanted everything in writing . She said it was in the manufacturing manuel but it was not . Therefore I never gave her a signature.  Texas is a community property state in which my husband and i sign on everything together. She said we would be getting a hot tub straight from.the factory  brand new !!!!!
I found out the delivery guys were not able to deliver same day or on the weekend as Jennifer stated so I called the store to lecture her. She denied and would not take accountability for her actions.  I asked to speak with the owner and she kept blocking me from talking to him  . I then wrote a bad review and Rob called me right away  justifying Jennifer's actions saying  she had a bad day and to give her another chance. I forgive but do not forget .  Rob apologized for her actions and said he would talk to her .

Today the delivery guys were late but the sweetest. We gave them water everthing. The spa had water in it so we had assumed it was from the ware house to check for leaks. The delivery guys told us it was damaged and had a missing part.

went up to bonnie and clydes to get the part but jennifer tried to say it was normal when it was not ! Its even in the manufacture manuel ! Then saw the floor model was gone so my husband asked if she sold us the floor model and she said yes like she was so proud. My husband then told her we need to speak with Rob bc this is not what was agreed to . She said he's not in once again!!!!

I went to Leslie's pool supply . They said they quit referring bonnie and clydes bc of the complaints of customers being lied to . Then I spoke to another location that Told us Dan is our go to for this and that Rob will dodge us and continue to justify everyones actions.  DAN is actually the owner not his friend that we thought. This individual also proceeded us to tell us about the whole family that works at these locations. Im not giving names but they really dont like their management teams at all. All we were told the whole time in our
experience was lies. This is our first hot tub and we were so excited to get one . Worst experience ever for the first !!! LIKE I SAID IF THIS IS NOT MADE RIGHT WELL TAKE OUR NEXT MOVE SINCE NOTHING HAS BEEN DONE . THE GRACE PERIOD DOES NOT.APPLY IN THIS SITUATION. Honesty comes a long way and if you lie to make a sell i will.expose you . I do not have sympathy for Anyone who does that. Business is business and the employees actions can not be justified. We do not trust this company at this point . I am requesting a resolution  in 3 business days or i will take  legal action .  As a business person. Myself an employee who is dishonest to make a sale gets fired in my industry. Our whole 1st experience.was ruined by lies and deception. Awful way to do business and im going to tell the owner all about it since he was not there to witness it all.  We have pictures and much more

Also we were told ppl test out the in-store models !!!! Like why sale us something used when it could have diseases or germs . Someone could have had aids and sat in it !!!!!
I have so many pics of the scuffs scratches and damages on it too !!!!!
reviews.author: Amandia Nordyke

reviews.text: We had our pool installed on April 8th and it's amazing. They did a wonderful job and took their time. They had to battle the terrible winds and redo a lot of stuff because of it, but they never faltered or complained. The N. Richland Hills location on Glenview Drive is awesome. The staff is very helpful and willing to take the time to answer any questions I may have. Now if the weather would just cooperate, I'd be able to get in it without freezing to death!
reviews.author: Sabrina Jenkins

reviews.text: Jerry was outstanding! He greeted me when I entered and quickly walked me through how to fix my problem. He took the time to educate me on replacing a pump on my sons pool while my son was away on vacation. He was very knowledgable and friendly you have a great asset working for you.
reviews.author: Donald Swingle

reviews.text: Very knowledgeable and friendly staff. They have tons of parts and supplies in stock.  Almost always have what I need, in stock
reviews.author: Isel Valenzuela

reviews.text: Great experience! We got a Hot tub and it was the perfect fit for us !
reviews.author: Kim Groff

reviews.text: The truth is that I am very satisfied to be a customer of this pool store. They have been there since the first day I went to fix my dolphin robot. They were very empathetic and considerate of the price, and very professional and kind... a week ago I returned with two of my robots that did not want to walk and for the second time they were excellent with me. I had a quick and honest diagnosis. They are very professional, kind and honest. I recommend this store and its associates 200%. Thank you for the support you have given me with my Dolphin Robots. Thank you God bless you. Lazara González
reviews.author: LYG Motor Sales

reviews.text: It is the first time that I have come to this place to receive repair services for my Robot (Pool Cleaner) and their attention and professionalism is very unusual. They are very friendly and courteous. They treat you with great familiarity and the same day they received the repair from my team. I love these kind people and their very reasonable costs.thanks 🙏
reviews.author: Lazara Gonzalez

reviews.text:
Right up front I debated taking off one or two stars for installation.

The bad first.  A&A Installation should not be used.  They don't stand behind their work and customer service is non-existent.  The list is long but the worst example was a slow leak I had all summer which turned into a large leak a couple weeks ago.  The culprit turned out to be a PVC coupling that WASN'T EVEN GLUED in place.

Again, DO NOT USE A&A INSTALLATION.

Now the good.  After giving up on the initial installer I called the store and spoke with Dan.  Owner? GM? Not exactly sure but he made some calls and was able to get Campbell Pool Installation out to take care of things.  They had everything taken apart, dug up, fixed, filled in, wiped down, lubed up, and running fine in a little over an hour.  So a big thank you to Dan and Campbell Pool Installation.  Also of note is the in-store support has always been very good with knowledgeable employees able to help and answer questions; Chandler in particular who was our salesman.
reviews.author: Brian Blatz

reviews.text:
We had a pool installed from them 3 years ago and I could write a book on how many different options and answers we have gotten from multiple people. Every time we call someone would contradict what we heard before.
The worst experience we have ever had for the past 3 years dealing with them.
Do yourself a favor and buy your things elsewhere and do your own research. You’ll be better off.

The installer-Campbells was great though.
reviews.author: Morgan Nobles

reviews.text: I have been a customer at the Decatur store for 20 years. I've bought 2 pools from them and almost all of my supplies and accessories - I always shop them first. Their customer service is incredible, and their employees are knowledgeable, friendly, and helpful. When I've had a problem, they've always been able to tell me how to fix it. I can't imagine going anywhere else for anything pool-related. If I could give them an extra star, I would!
reviews.author: shelley s

reviews.text: I have been a pool owner for 4 years now. Don't waste your time going to Leslie's. This is this place. Very helpful and always have exactly what you need. The customer service and overall knowledge is exceptional. 10/10
reviews.author: Christina Branch

reviews.text: Ordered some gaskets from this place and never heard from them again. Called twice to check on them and always got oh yea we’ll have those in on our truck tomorrow.  Found the gaskets on Amazon.
reviews.author: David Horton

reviews.text: Been dealing with this company since I bought my pool. At first I was known on a first name basis. But last few years they seem to get different employees and services vary every year. Some employees are very knowledgeable, but others seem to wish you hadn't come in. I have learned what to do with the water quality in the pool myself so I don't go in as much. I would recommend them to anyone. I just cringe at who I get when I go in, knowing I will have to be back soon for second opinion.
reviews.author: Larry Walls

reviews.text: Jennifer is awesome. The whole staff is awesome. They set us up with our 21 foot round we got it installed and up and running. I have called several times with questions and they are always friendly and give great educated advice. Thanks guys for our awesome pool
reviews.author: DUCKY

reviews.text: Be careful using their contractors for installation or repair. ALLSTAR POOLS replaced our pool liner at the beginning of summer. They did not show up when they said  they would, when they did install the liner they cut the hole for the skimmer too big or pulled the liner up too far  so when we filled it with water it stretched below the skimmer and tore. They did come out and replaced the liner at no cost. But they cut the hole for the return too big so it’s been leaking all summer. We have to add water every couple days. Also there is a big rock under the liner. We tried calling them, they would not return our calls, we told Bonnie and Clyde’s they said they would have them call us, they still didn’t (B&C didn’t seem interested in the issue). I sent All Star 1 more text saying that I would leave a bad review if they didn’t return our call. They did call, they came out a week later looked at it said they were going to get a part to fix it, never showed back up. My husband called, they said they would be out the next day, they did not show up and will not answer any text or calls from us now. So we have an $800.00 dollar liner replacement that leaks worse than the one they replaced and the rock will probably punch through eventually.
reviews.author: Jamie Bailey

reviews.text: Very dissatisfied with service due to a faulty vacuum.  Purchased it and within 4 days I called and mentioned that it wasn’t doing its job and a gentleman told me no problem return it and you will be refunded.   So today I called to confirm time to go in and now I’m told I have to keep it because it was opened.  The point of not knowing it was faulty is that you have to open the product to see how it works not guess at it.
reviews.author: gHOsT

reviews.text: I love my pool I purchased the 15x30 Morada from Josh he is very knowledge all in all the experience has been very positive.  The challenge has been with Campbell Installations I would not recommend them they had to come back 5 times to fix the light that I purchased with the pool each time it was there error.  They destroyed my backyard which they finally fixed to some degree.  I found there customer service to be rude.  The time they cost me with the errors cost me time from my business and monies that I did not need to waste.  If you purchase your pool be sure and DO NOT have Campbell do the install it will cost you.
reviews.author: Donna Reis

reviews.text: Fixed our pool motor at a pretty decent price!! Would highly recommend!! Took about a week , which isn't bad.  Said it was due to all the other motors they had to fix! Everything was fixed on it and thank God we didn't need a new motor.  So thanks to Bonnie and clydes....we will be up and running and able to swim again in about a day or 2. Woohoo!!

I seriously love this place. They have everything for your pool and spa. If they don't have what you are looking for, they will gladly give you recommendation where to find it. They will not leave you high and dry.

Josh will take the time and sit with you and explain everything about your pool and how to fix/maintain it. The pool parts and chemicals are actually cheaper than Leslies and it's the same stuff!

I've been going to this place for over a year and they haven't steered me wrong about my pool and spa.
